angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 20,571,153 km at 133.86 pc = 2.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 74793: distance 133.864 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.088), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 133.864 +/- 11.78 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 7.9260 +/- 0.0874 mas (same row, RUWE 0.96), 90.7 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 29.569 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 74793: radius 29.569 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 257.257 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.106) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 20,571,153 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4254 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 74793: effective temperature 4254 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.044) (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 74793: effective temperature 4254 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.044) (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's measured spectrum (HST/STIS Next Generation Spectral Library v2 (Heap & Lindler; MAST high-level science product), HD 136726) (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.

surfaceGravitySource: log g 1.78 from 2024A&A...682A.145S; the 25 published values span log g -0.49 to 2.06 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A%26A...682A.145S)
